source.title: IoT sensor data XGain UC6
source.access: public; direct anonymous HTTP download succeeded
source.license: CC BY 4.0 in Zenodo record; attached README states CC BY-NC, creating a rights conflict
source.licenseStatus: CONDITIONAL; not cleared for commercial training because the deposited README says CC BY-NC
rightsEvidence: README_IoT sensor data.txt embedded in the downloaded archive states CC BY-NC.
Conservative use gate: descriptive exploration only until the rights conflict is resolved from the record itself; no contact or permission request made.

population.system: pasture access; metadata says 07:30–14:00 daily for approximately three weeks
population.animalIdentifiers: 10 ear-tag IDs embedded in workbook filenames; retained as opaque string IDs
population.unitOfObservation: animal-hour with counts of one-minute class outputs
population.timeZone: not specified in source; timestamps are preserved as naive local time

measurement.releasedMeasurement: processed hourly behavior class counts, not raw accelerometer signals
measurement.targetProvenance: The record says a supervised decision tree produced labels. The README says observers provided ground truth during model training/validation, but no human-reference labels or raw sensor trace are included in this download.
measurement.unit: count of one-minute class predictions per hour; each row sums to 60

limitations: Class counts are classifier outputs, not independent human-reference labels.
Raw IMU and event-level timestamps are not present in the published ZIP.
Zenodo record and embedded README declare conflicting reuse licenses.

The files contain 24-hour timestamps despite metadata describing daily pasture access from 07:30 to 14:00; verify with the data package authors only if the record is revised publicly (do not contact them).
